solutions.title: Iterative binary exponentiation
solutions.strategy: Scan exponent bits from least significant to most significant, squaring the base after every bit.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every iteration halves the remaining exponent magnitude.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The loop keeps a constant number of numeric variables.

solutions.title: Recursive binary exponentiation
solutions.strategy: Recursively compute the half power and square it, multiplying by the base for odd exponents.

timeComplexity.explanation: The exponent is divided by two at every recursive step.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The recursion stack has one frame per exponent halving.
